ocl.definition: card:BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(c | c.CardID = cardid), newCard:BankCard, bool:Boolean
ocl.postcondition: (if card.oclIsUndefined() = true then let newCard:BankCard in newCard.oclIsNew() and BankCard.allInstance()->includes(newCard) and newCard.CardID = cardid and newCard.CardStatus = cardstatus and newCard.Catalog = catalog and newCard.Password = password and newCard.Balance = balance and bool = true else card.CardStatus = cardstatus and card.Catalog = catalog and card.Password = password and card.Balance = balance and bool = true endif) and result = bool
